The bootstrap recipe — how to use the engine 
<script src="…/vendor/zrender.min.js"></script>   <!-- UMD: publishes window.zrender -->
<div id="sisflow-mine" class="sisflow-canvas" tabindex="0"></div>  <!-- needs an explicit height -->

<script type="module">
import sisflow from '…/sisflow/index.js';
import { SISMAYA_LIGHT } from '…/sisflow/theme/themes.js';

// Token tables ship as plain exports, not pre-registered — name one yourself.
sisflow.themes.register('sismaya-light', SISMAYA_LIGHT);

const flow = sisflow.create(document.getElementById('sisflow-mine'), {
  renderer: 'canvas',                                    // or 'svg'
  theme: 'sismaya-light',                                // resolved once, here
  grid: { size: 8, snap: true },                         // drag/palette snapping
  layout: sisflow.layouts.layered({ direction: 'right' }),  // or tree / scoped, or omit
  edges: { route: 'ortho', corner: 6, jumpOver: true },
});

// Define every shape the document names BEFORE loading it — the schema rejects
// unknown shape names. Only step/roundRect/pill/diamond/card/boundary are built in.
flow.shapes.define('box', {
  body: { kind: 'roundRect', radius: 6 },
  label: { bind: 'label' },
  anchors: ['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left'],
  size: { w: 160, h: 48 },
});
flow.shapes.define('link', { edge: true, markerEnd: 'standard' });

// The document. Unknown keys are hard errors; load() throws SchemaError with a
// full error list and leaves the graph untouched.
flow.graph.load({
  sisflow: 2,
  nodes: [
    { id: 'a', shape: 'box', x: 40, y: 40, data: { label: 'One', kind: 'start' } },
    { id: 'b', shape: 'box', x: 40, y: 160, data: { label: 'Two' } },
  ],
  edges: [{ id: 'e1', from: 'a', to: 'b', shape: 'link', data: { label: 'next' } }],
});

flow.commands.zoomToFit(24);

// From here: flow.graph, .commands, .history, .selection, .tools, .styles,
// .export.toSVG() / .toSQL() / .toDataURL(), flow.on('change', …), flow.dispose().
</script>

Flowchart

Hand-placed process flow over the ISO 5807 shape catalog. No layout descriptor, so authored positions are preserved; edges route orthogonally with line jumps where they cross.

System Architecture
